title: GoPro, Inc. 8-K Filing — 2026-04-07
summary: GoPro, Inc. announced on April 7, 2026 that its Board approved a restructuring plan involving a global reduction in force of approximately 145 employees (23% of 631 headcount), with estimated aggregate charges of $11.5M to $15M and cash expenditures of $1.5M in Q2, $5.5M-$8M in Q3, and $4.5M-$5.5M in Q4 2026.
key_points: Board approved restructuring plan on April 7, 2026
Reduction in force of 145 employees representing approximately 23% of the company's ending Q1 2026 headcount of 631
Estimated aggregate charge range of $11.5 million to $15 million
Cash expenditures: ~$1.5M in Q2 2026, ~$5.5M-$8M in Q3 2026, ~$4.5M-$5.5M in Q4 2026
One-time termination benefits include severance payments and healthcare benefits
Restructuring expected to be substantially completed by end of 2026
